description: We are team of high school students excited to gain an unforgettable experience :)
summary:
Throughout history, machines like the Lunar Roving Vehicle, Sojourner, Opportunity, Viking 1 and 2, and the Kepler Space Telescope have helped humanity explore the universe. They discovered new worlds, collected important information, and changed our understanding of space.
However, when their missions ended, their stories were often forgotten. People usually hear about space exploration from scientists, but we want to show a different perspective: the perspective of the machines themselves.

details: Our team is making a comic about inactive space vehicles, including Opportunity, each vehicle tells its story, sharing its mission and discoveries. We combine researched facts, AI-assisted illustrations and storytelling to make space history engaging and easy to understand. We focus on accuracy, creativity and young readers.
dataRefs: Ay Modüllerinin (Apollo 11'in Eagle'ı gibi ) iniş aşamaları, fırlatma rampası olarak geride bırakıldı.
Astronotlar tarafından kullanılan üç elektrikli \"ay arabası\". Ay'da kalıcı olarak park halinde bulunuyorlar.
Astronotlar ayrıldıktan sonra bilimsel çalışmalar yapmak üzere bırakılan Apollo Ay Yüzeyi Deney Paketleri (sismometreler, retroreflektörler vb.).
Yumuşak inişlerin mümkün olduğunu kanıtlamak için 1960'larda gönderilen robotik sondalar.
